title: Add Finviz gross entry budget and pacing guard
description: The Finviz direct lane currently enforces open-position capacity (max_open_positions) and per-run burst capacity (max_new_positions_per_run), but it does not enforce a gross daily/session entry budget. That means exits free capacity and total same-day entries can exceed what an operator intuitively expects from the open cap. Add separate entry-budget controls without banning legitimate same-day repeat trades.
acceptance_criteria: Finviz direct config supports max_daily_entries or max_session_entries separately from max_open_positions; direct-run decisions include max_daily_entries_reached when the gross budget is hit; operator views show filled entries today, remaining entry budget, open position count, and max open positions as separate numbers; same-symbol repeat trades remain allowed when budget remains and setup reset criteria pass; live validation confirms no new entries after the gross budget is reached while exits/close management continue normally.
close_reason: Implemented max_daily_entries/max_session_entries guard for Finviz direct trading, surfaced session entry budget in ledger/live-doctor/console views, deployed scheduler/runtime/API restart, and live-validated the 2026-06-02 18:02Z direct run created 0 intents with max_daily_entries_reached for all 10 entry candidates at budget 12/10.

title: Surface close lifecycle anomalies in ops views
description: We had to use SQL/logs to distinguish historical close failures from current close health. Add a focused close lifecycle/anomaly surface to the CLI/dashboard so operators can immediately see failed close attempts, pending close attempts, stale reconciliation skips, intent-mismatch rejects, and latest filled close proof by position.
acceptance_criteria: live-doctor or a shipped ops CLI shows recent close attempts by status, latest close failure, active/pending close attempts, stale-reconciliation skip count, and latest filled close per open/closed position; Grafana/dashboard exposes the same focused panel without unrelated system logs; validation uses live paper data and requires no automated tests unless explicitly requested.
close_reason: Implemented close lifecycle summaries across live-doctor, Finviz ledger, positions API, and operator positions dashboard. Live/deployed validation: py_compile, diff check, focused web lint, live finviz-ledger close_status=healthy active=0 pending=0 failed=0 stale=3 mismatch=0, live-doctor close_status=healthy, deployed API routes returned close_lifecycle payloads, and web /positions returned 200.

title: Require fresh Finviz setup before same-symbol re-entry
description: Same-day repeat trades are allowed. The risk is not multiple trades; it is immediately re-entering the same stale setup after an invalidation/stop-style exit without evidence that the symbol has reset. Add a simple re-entry reset guard for the Finviz direct lane: allow another trade in the same symbol when a fresh setup forms, but block stale duplicate re-entry against the same feed/setup state.
acceptance_criteria: A symbol can be traded multiple times in the same day when a new Finviz/direct setup is observed after the prior exit; immediate stale re-entry after stop_loss, stop_multiple, underlying_vwap_recent_low_break, or equivalent invalidation is blocked until reset criteria pass; decision output distinguishes same_symbol_setup_not_reset from normal buy_timing_not_ready/spread_too_wide reasons; live validation shows repeat same-day trades remain possible while stale duplicate re-entry is blocked.
close_reason: Implemented a same-symbol re-entry reset guard for Finviz direct trading. Stale same-day re-entry after invalidation exits now returns same_symbol_setup_not_reset until a newer feed snapshot after the prior close is observed; repeat trades remain allowed after the feed reset. Validation: py_compile and diff check passed; focused runtime smoke covered stale block, fresh allow, and hold-exit allow; deployed by restarting worker-runtime; live direct runs at 2026-06-02T18:04Z and 18:06Z completed cleanly, but today’s max_daily_entries cap masks the live repeat-entry branch.

title: Gate exit manager on fresh broker reconciliation
description: The close guard now prevents bad sell_to_close submissions, but exit-manager can still run in the same minute as broker-sync and briefly evaluate positions before the freshest reconciliation has landed. Add an explicit freshness gate so exit-manager only evaluates close decisions against a current broker-sync snapshot, or skips with a clear non-actionable reason when broker-sync is stale/in-flight.
acceptance_criteria: Exit-manager records the broker-sync snapshot/freshness used for each run; if broker sync is stale or unavailable it skips without evaluating closes; after broker-sync completes it evaluates only currently open matched positions; live validation over multiple market-hour ticks shows no closed-position stale decisions and no failed close attempts.
close_reason: Validated live exit-manager broker-sync gate: latest :45Z runs succeeded after broker_sync, recorded current broker snapshot, evaluated 3 matched open positions, and had failure_count=0.

title: Expose Nautilus bridge logs in central observability
description: Expose Nautilus bridge/runtime log output in the central Loki/Grafana stack. Today the Nautilus Docker compose project only contributes backing-service logs, while the active bridge runs as a Spreads subprocess and its stdout/stderr are captured instead of emitted to the central app log surface.
acceptance_criteria: Nautilus bridge subprocess stdout/stderr are emitted as structured app logs without leaking full handoff payloads; central Trading Logs/Grafana view has a clear Nautilus bridge/runtime surface; Loki queries can show bridge events from Spreads workers and future Nautilus app container logs; live validation proves the labels/query return recent bridge evidence or a controlled synthetic bridge log without submitting orders; no automated tests are added unless explicitly requested.
close_reason: Exposed active Nautilus bridge logs in central observability. Spreads now emits bridge submit start/success/failure plus bounded bridge subprocess stdout/stderr as structured JSON with component=nautilus_bridge, log_origin_project=nautilus, and log_origin_service=bridge, while skipping the final success result JSON and avoiding full handoff payload logging. Added Nautilus Bridge And Runtime volume/log panels to the central Trading Logs Grafana dashboard, covering bridge logs currently emitted from Spreads app containers and future project=nautilus app container streams. Documented the current bridge-through-Spreads boundary in nucbox-observability README. Validation: py_compile packages/core/services/execution/nautilus_bridge.py, jq parsed grafana/dashboards/trading-logs.json, git diff --check in both repos, Loki query syntax checks passed, restarted worker-runtime and Grafana, synthetic fake bridge command emitted stdout/stderr without submitting orders, Loki returned 4 component=nautilus_bridge records via the dashboard selector, and Grafana API shows the new Nautilus panels loaded. Live-doctor after worker restart kept scheduler/workers/feed/direct/close/Nautilus bridge healthy with market closed and no open positions; remaining BLOCKED is the pre-existing entries=12/10 daily cap state, with broker sync idle/stale after market close.

title: Live-validate Finviz same-symbol re-entry reset after budget reset
description: After the gross daily entry budget resets on a future market session, live-validate that same_symbol_setup_not_reset appears for stale same-symbol invalidation re-entry and that a later fresh Finviz feed setup can allow a repeat same-day trade when other caps permit.
acceptance_criteria: Live ledger/direct-run evidence shows a stale same-symbol invalidation re-entry blocked with same_symbol_setup_not_reset; a later fresh feed snapshot for the same symbol is allowed to proceed to normal timing/option selection when budget and open caps permit; findings are recorded on this bead or the parent implementation bead.

title: Measure Finviz option selection and fill quality
description: Before making more strategy changes, capture the facts around selected contracts: spread, bid/ask/mid, fill price, slippage, volume/open interest when available, option age, exit reason, and realized outcome. This lets us tune strike/expiry/liquidity rules from our own live paper trail instead of guessing.
acceptance_criteria: Each Finviz direct entry/exit records option-selection metrics and fill-quality metrics in the ledger/read model; daily summary reports selected contract quality, fill slippage, exit reason, and outcome by symbol; the data is visible from a shipped CLI or dashboard; no automated tests are added unless explicitly requested.
close_reason: Added Finviz option-selection and fill-quality metrics to the existing ledger/read model without adding schema or tests. Each summarized attempt now carries option_selection facts from the execution intent payload plus fill_quality derived from limit price, selected quote bid/ask/mid, fill price, fill side, spread capture, limit improvement, midpoint slippage, quote spread, quote age, and estimated notional. Positions now include compact entry/latest-close quality, the ledger summary includes weighted daily quality averages, and details.quality_by_symbol reports selected contracts, entry/exit counts, spread, quote age, entry/exit slippage, DTE/delta/volume/OI where present, exit reasons, and PnL by symbol. Validation: py_compile packages/core/services/ops/finviz.py and packages/core/cli/ops_render.py, git diff --check, live CLI finviz-ledger --env ade-nucbox-k8-plus --json returned healthy with 12 entries, 12 exits, 8 quality_by_symbol rows, populated sample entry/exit option_selection and fill_quality; human CLI renders the Finviz Option Fill Quality table; internal API /internal/ops/finviz-ledger returned the same quality summary. Live-doctor remained operational with scheduler/workers/feed/direct/close healthy, market closed, open positions 0, active intents 0; the only BLOCKED flag is the pre-existing entries=12/10 daily cap state.

title: Automate quote and event retention visibility
description: We already hard-pruned stale quote/event data and have an off-hours VACUUM FULL bead, but quote storage needs continuous visibility and retention so it does not become a periodic emergency. Add operator-visible retention metrics and a scheduled retention path for high-volume quote/event tables.
acceptance_criteria: Ops view shows table sizes, retained date ranges, rows pruned in the latest retention run, and whether VACUUM FULL is pending; scheduled retention runs off the live market path and avoids market-hours heavy locks; live validation records before/after table sizes and confirms market-recorder/feed/direct jobs stay healthy.
close_reason: Added retention status visibility for high-volume quote/trade/event tables through the shipped CLI and internal ops API. Status now reports table sizes, retained ranges, latest retention run/matched/deleted counts, and whether VACUUM FULL is pending, with the off-hours schedule surfaced as 30 22 * * 1-5 and ops log discovery via SPREADS_OPS_LOG_DIR. Live validation: py_compile touched Python files, git diff --check, docker compose config, deploy env render includes SPREADS_OPS_LOG_DIR, one-time ops/retention_prune.sh run wrote logs/ops/retention.log and deleted 0 rows because no stale rows remained, CLI/API retention status returned healthy with option_quote_events ~42,951,460 rows/14.8GB/dead=0, option_trade_events ~252,482 rows/122MB/dead=0, event_log ~2,223,264 rows/8.5GB/dead=0, vacuum_full_pending=false, and live-doctor stayed operational with scheduler/workers/feed/direct/close healthy. Remaining live-doctor BLOCKED is the pre-existing 12/10 daily entry cap usage with market closed and no open positions.

title: Add adaptive option close repricing
description: Current option closes have filled in paper, but a fixed close limit can miss exits in fast/illiquid contracts. Add a small, bounded cancel/replace path for option exits so profit/stop/force-close orders can move toward marketability without creating duplicate close exposure.
acceptance_criteria: Close attempts have an age/TTL and one active close per position; unfilled close orders can be canceled/replaced according to a configured repricing policy; replacement attempts preserve sell_to_close and position_id linkage; ops views show original and replacement orders; live paper validation proves no duplicate close and a successful close/final skip path.

comments.author: ade b
comments.text: Implemented bounded Finviz long-call close repricing behind the existing execution-intent manager. Config: option_exit_rules.repricing enabled with stale_after_seconds=75, max_reprices=3, price_step=0.01, max_concession=0.03. Replacement intents preserve sell_to_close, position_id, original/previous limits, previous_execution_attempt_id, and supersedes_execution_intent_id; finviz-ledger now renders recent close attempts with reprice/limit chain. Validation 2026-06-02: config validate ok; py_compile ok with temp pycache; git diff --check ok; synthetic fake-store smoke moved a close sell limit 1.00 -> 0.99, preserved position_id=position-1 and position_intent=sell_to_close, and exhausted after max_reprices; restarted scheduler, worker-runtime, worker-discovery; live-doctor on ade-nucbox-k8-plus was IDLE/healthy with active close attempts=0 and active intents=0. Remaining: market was closed and there were no open positions, so live broker cancel/replace/fill proof still needs the next stale close order.

title: Run off-hours VACUUM FULL after stale quote prune
description:
We hard-pruned stale raw capture on 2026-06-02, deleting 24,235,545 option_quote_events rows and 4,886,632 raw market event_log rows. Normal VACUUM (ANALYZE) cleared dead tuples, but the Postgres database files still report about 23GB because VACUUM FULL was intentionally skipped during live trading. Run only off-hours if OS-visible disk reclamation is still desired.

Recommended runbook:
1. Confirm market is closed and live-doctor is healthy before maintenance.
2. Pause/stop market-recorder plus runtime/discovery workers or put the stack in maintenance mode so writes will not compete with table rewrites.
3. Run VACUUM FULL (ANALYZE) option_quote_events; then VACUUM FULL (ANALYZE) event_log; from the spreads Postgres container.
4. Check pg_database_size, table sizes, disk usage, and logs.
5. Restart paused services and verify live-doctor, Finviz feed/direct health, broker sync, open positions, and actionable failed jobs.

Avoid running VACUUM FULL during market hours because it takes strong table locks and can block live reads/writes.
acceptance_criteria: VACUUM FULL completed off-hours for option_quote_events and event_log, services restarted, live-doctor healthy, and before/after DB/disk sizes recorded.

title: Port long-vol options strategies
description: Port the long straddle and long strangle strategy family into Nautilus after the close-runtime path proves clean in paper. Keep the implementation aligned with the existing regular-strategy pattern, including future buy/sell equity support, without turning it into a dry-run-only path.
acceptance_criteria: Long straddle and long strangle configs/routing exist as regular strategies; validation allows their option-leg shape separately from vertical spreads; execution intents carry enough metadata for Nautilus open/close lifecycle proof.
